faqs.question: How do rigid boxes differ from folding cartons?
faqs.answer: Rigid boxes generally use a thicker board with a separate wrapping material. Folding cartons typically fold from paperboard. Some rigid structures are collapsible; confirm the supplied format for your style.

faqs.question: Can rigid boxes ship without an outer carton?
faqs.answer: Do not assume a presentation box provides transit protection. Describe your packing and delivery requirements so protective materials and an outer carton can be considered.
